title: DiD: Policy Effect on Employment
description: Causal inference workflow using difference-in-differences to estimate the effect of a policy intervention on employment outcomes from administrative claims data. Three phases: data preparation (acquire, clean, construct sample), analysis (construct variables, run diagnostics, estimate), and validation/output (robustness checks, reporting).
_objective: Estimate the causal effect of a policy intervention on employment outcomes using difference-in-differences with administrative claims data.

modules.label: Data Preparation
modules.description: Acquire administrative claims data, standardize formats, and construct the analysis sample with treatment and control groups.

modules.label: Data Acquisition
modules.description: Obtain raw administrative claims records and policy adoption dates from source databases or file transfers.

inputs.name: claims_source
inputs.description: Administrative claims database or flat file extract

inputs.name: policy_schedule
inputs.format: CSV with columns: jurisdiction_id, adoption_date, policy_variant

outputs.name: raw_claims
outputs.description: Unprocessed claims records with all original fields
outputs.format: Parquet or CSV, one file per source year

modules.label: Data Cleaning
modules.description: Standardize field formats, resolve coding inconsistencies, deduplicate records, and handle missing values.

outputs.name: clean_claims
outputs.description: Standardized claims with consistent coding, no duplicates, missing values flagged
outputs.format: Parquet with columns: person_id, date, jurisdiction, employment_status, ...

modules.label: Sample Construction
modules.checkpointReason: Inclusion/exclusion criteria (age range, tenure, industry, geographic scope) and treatment/control group definitions are substantive choices that affect external validity and the estimand
modules.description: Apply sample restrictions, define treatment and control groups based on policy adoption timing, and construct a balanced panel.

outputs.name: analysis_sample
outputs.description: Balanced panel with treatment/control assignment and sample restriction flags
outputs.format: Parquet with columns: person_id, period, jurisdiction, treated, post, in_sample

modules.label: Analysis
modules.description: Construct analytical variables, verify identifying assumptions, and estimate the causal effect.

modules.label: Variable Construction
modules.checkpointReason: Outcome operationalization (employment indicator vs hours vs earnings vs labor force participation), control variable selection, and treatment intensity coding require domain expertise and may determine the sign and magnitude of the estimate
modules.description: Define and compute outcome variables, treatment indicators, and time-varying controls from the analysis sample.

outputs.name: analytical_dataset
outputs.description: Panel with outcome Y, treatment D, post indicator, interaction DxPost, and control vector X

modules.label: Pre-Estimation Diagnostics
modules.checkpointReason: Parallel trends test specification (number of leads/lags, functional form) and interpretation of results require econometric judgment — a marginal failure may or may not invalidate the design
modules.description: Test the parallel trends assumption, check for anticipation effects, and assess covariate balance between treatment and control groups.

outputs.name: diagnostic_results
outputs.description: Pre-trends coefficients, balance table, event-study pre-period plot data
outputs.format: JSON with arrays: pre_trend_coefs, balance_stats, event_study_data

modules.label: Main Estimation
modules.checkpointReason: DiD specification (TWFE vs robust estimator), standard error clustering level (jurisdiction vs state vs person), and whether to use covariates or not are methodological decisions with direct impact on the point estimate and inference
modules.description: Estimate the average treatment effect on the treated using the chosen DiD specification with appropriate standard errors.

outputs.name: did_estimates
outputs.description: Point estimate, standard error, confidence interval, event-study coefficients
outputs.format: JSON with fields: att, se, ci_lower, ci_upper, event_study[]

modules.label: Validation & Output
modules.description: Validate findings through robustness checks and compile into publication-ready output.

modules.label: Robustness Checks
modules.checkpointReason: Which robustness checks are appropriate depends on the empirical setting: alternative outcome measures, different control groups, varying treatment windows, placebo jurisdictions, leave-one-out sensitivity
modules.description: Run sensitivity analyses to assess whether the main finding is robust to alternative specifications, sample definitions, and placebo tests.

outputs.name: robustness_table
outputs.description: Matrix of estimates across specifications with main result highlighted
outputs.format: CSV with columns: specification, estimate, se, ci_lower, ci_upper, note

modules.label: Reporting
modules.description: Generate publication-ready tables, event-study plots, and a results narrative.

outputs.name: figures
outputs.description: Event-study plot, pre-trends plot, robustness comparison

outputs.name: results_draft
outputs.description: Narrative results section with embedded references to tables and figures

nodes.label: acquire.import_claims
nodes.description: Import raw administrative claims records from source database or flat file extract.

nodes.label: acquire.load_policy_dates
nodes.description: Load policy adoption schedule mapping jurisdictions to adoption dates.

nodes.label: acquire.merge_sources
nodes.description: Merge claims records with policy adoption dates on jurisdiction and time period.

nodes.label: clean.standardize_fields
nodes.description: Harmonize field names, date formats, and coding schemes across source years.

nodes.label: clean.deduplicate
nodes.description: Remove duplicate claims records using person-date-jurisdiction matching.

nodes.label: clean.flag_missing
nodes.description: Identify and flag records with missing key fields; apply imputation or exclusion rules.

nodes.label: sample.apply_criteria
nodes.description: Apply inclusion criteria: age range, tenure, industry, geographic scope.

nodes.label: sample.assign_groups
nodes.description: Assign treatment and control group status based on jurisdiction policy adoption timing.

nodes.label: sample.construct_panel
nodes.description: Construct balanced panel from assigned groups, handling entry and exit over time.

nodes.label: variables.define_outcome
nodes.description: Operationalize the employment outcome: indicator (0/1), hours worked, earnings, or LFP.

nodes.label: variables.code_treatment
nodes.description: Construct treatment dummy (D), post-period indicator, and the interaction term DxPost.

nodes.label: variables.select_controls
nodes.description: Choose and compute control variables: demographics, pre-treatment outcomes, jurisdiction characteristics.

nodes.label: diagnostic.parallel_trends
nodes.description: Regress outcome on leads of treatment to test for differential pre-trends between groups.

nodes.label: diagnostic.covariate_balance
nodes.description: Compare covariate distributions between treatment and control groups; flag imbalances.

nodes.label: diagnostic.assess_validity
nodes.description: Evaluate whether diagnostics support proceeding with estimation or require specification revision.

nodes.label: estimate.specify_model
nodes.description: Choose DiD estimator (TWFE, Callaway-Sant'Anna, or other robust estimator) and SE clustering level.

nodes.label: estimate.run_regression
nodes.description: Estimate the model and compute the ATT with clustered standard errors.

nodes.label: estimate.event_study
nodes.description: Estimate dynamic treatment effects by event time to examine effect trajectory.

nodes.label: robustness.alt_specifications
nodes.description: Re-estimate under alternative outcome definitions, control sets, sample windows, and estimators.

nodes.label: robustness.placebo_tests
nodes.description: Run placebo tests with fake treatment dates and untreated-only subsamples.

nodes.label: reporting.generate_tables
nodes.description: Produce LaTeX regression tables, summary statistics, and robustness comparison matrix.

nodes.label: reporting.write_narrative
nodes.description: Draft the results section interpreting the estimates, diagnostics, and robustness findings.

edges.label: standardize
edges.description: Pass merged raw claims to cleaning pipeline for format harmonization.

edges.label: apply criteria
edges.description: Pass clean claims to sample construction for inclusion/exclusion filtering.

edges.label: construct variables
edges.description: Pass balanced analysis sample to variable construction for outcome and treatment coding.

edges.label: run diagnostics
edges.description: Pass complete analytical dataset to pre-estimation diagnostics for assumption testing.

edges.label: design valid
edges.description: Proceed to estimation if parallel trends hold and covariates are balanced.

edges.label: revise spec
edges.description: If diagnostics fail, return to variable construction to adjust outcome definition or controls.

edges.label: check robustness
edges.description: Pass main estimates to robustness module for sensitivity analysis across specifications.

edges.label: generate output
edges.description: Pass all estimation and robustness results to reporting for table and figure generation.

edges.label: write narrative
edges.description: Draft the results narrative interpreting the findings; requires domain expertise for framing.
